intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Redmond for 2026, and here is what he found: 8 family events, 3 of them free. New in this update: Santa Photos at Redmond Town Center (from November 27), Eastside Symphony Holiday Traditions at Robertson Performing Arts Center (December 6) and Holiday Movies in the Court at Redmond Town Center (from December 11). We check every date on the host’s own website or an official city calendar, and each listing links straight there. For the rest of the state, see our Washington Christmas events for kids guide.

Planning a bigger day out? Redmond families also use our guide to Christmas events for kids in Seattle, which covers Seattle Center Winterfest, WildLanterns, the North Pole Limited Santa train and more.

What Rally found in Redmond

  • 8 Christmas events for kids in Redmond
  • 3 free to attend
  • Meet Santa: Santa Photos at Redmond Town Center (from November 27)
  • Also on the list: 2 shows, 1 light display and 1 craft or cookie event
  • New events in this update run November 27 to December 24
  • Every date checked on the host’s own site or an official city calendar on Nov 26
